size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)

machine.type: bull-block wire drawer per the duty sheet and the AQS-MFG-010 tool row (Table 2.1, rev C metering split), built on the DRAW accepted idiom (commit 30f5abf4) scaled to the node box: steel bench bed on legs, die stand with the tungsten-carbide die set in tool-steel casings (consumable buy set), bull-block take-up drum OD 300 with shaft, wire-guide sheaves, draw-fume extraction hood over the die zone, drive group and control cabinet as purchased envelopes; die-zone/drum guard rail (A-MACH) + hold-down frame
machine.tool_row: AQS-MFG-010 Table 2.1: Bull-block wire drawer, nameplate 1.1 kW; energy basis 250 MPa x strain 3.0 / 0.55 (DIETER1988) = 0.0423 kWh/kg + no-load 15 % x 1 h (A-M-177)

bench.basis: DRAW bench idiom scaled to the node box; study sections (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

die_set.basis: tungsten-carbide drawing dies in tool-steel casings (duty section 3 class, DIETER1988 ch. 20/21); consumable buy set; the die count is a study value (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

bull_block.basis: study drum size (hold, WORK_ORDER W12); the capstan hardware carries the machine lubricant programme - no wetted stream (duty section 3)

machine.fume: the N4 draw-fume row routes to the house scrubber train; the extraction hood over the die zone is the layout choice (W12)
machine.purchased: drive group and control cabinet on their bays, drawn as their envelopes per plan rule 6 (nameplate 1.1 kW is the node stamp); the carbide die set is the purchased consumable
machine.guard: four-post hold-down/guard frame pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); die-zone and drum guard rail on 4 posts x 3 tiers; 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)
machine.material: 316L where the stream is wet (duty section 3); dry forming machine - CA 0 mm

N8.note: vent flush at the envelope top; the 800 datum is the box top
